title: Skill evals file
description: Test cases for evaluating one Memgraph Agent Skill, per the agentskills.io 'Evaluating skills' methodology. Lives at skills/<skill>/evals/evals.json.

skill_name.description: Directory name of the skill under skills/, e.g. 'memgraph-cypher-syntax'.

id.description: Unique id for the case within this file.

name.description: Optional human-readable name; becomes the run directory (slugified, prefixed with 'eval-'). Defaults to 'eval-<id>'.

prompt.description: A realistic prompt a user would actually type.

expected_output.description: Plain-language description of what a successful response looks like.

files.description: Optional input file paths (relative to the skill's evals/ dir) whose contents are appended to the prompt as context.

assertions.description: Concrete, independently checkable statements. Each is graded PASS/FAIL by an LLM judge with no benefit of the doubt.
